tasks.title: Adopt Brazil-specific AML/CFT/CPF policy framework
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 transition obligations; Circular 3,978/2020; IN 704 Annex IV assurance scope
tasks.why: BVI policies are useful raw material but do not demonstrate Brazilian regulatory compliance by themselves.
actions: Map existing BVI AML policies against Circular 3,978 and Brazil-specific VASP requirements.
Draft Brazilian addendum or standalone Portuguese-controlled policy set where necessary.
Define governance, risk-based approach, roles, recordkeeping and regulatory reporting.
Submit policy for required board/diretoria approval.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Approved Brazil-specific framework covers applicable requirements and can be tested by the independent auditor.

tasks.title: Complete Brazil institutional AML risk assessment
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Circular 3,978 risk-based requirements; IN 704 Annex IV
tasks.why: The risk assessment should drive the actual controls, not merely explain them after the fact.
actions: Assess customer, product/service, channel, geography, transaction and counterparty/VASP risks.
Include stablecoins, self-hosted wallets, foreign VASPs, PIX funding and BVI custody flows.
Document inherent risk, control effectiveness, residual risk and treatment.
Map higher-risk scenarios to EDD and monitoring controls.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brazil AML risk assessment is approved, current and demonstrably drives onboarding, monitoring and escalation thresholds.

tasks.title: Operationalize KYC/KYB, UBO, PEP and EDD procedures
tasks.involved: AML Director; Product; Sumsub owner; Fitbank owner
tasks.why: BCB will care whether procedures operate in the Brazil customer journey, not whether Sumsub exists somewhere in the group technology diagram.
actions: Define Brazil onboarding data requirements and verification standards.
Document Kinetic-to-Rules/Sumsub responsibilities and legal basis for outsourcing/data sharing.
Implement UBO, PEP, sanctions, adverse-media and high-risk escalation rules.
Confirm periodic and event-driven review logic.
Test cases end-to-end and retain evidence.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brazil customer lifecycle controls operate end-to-end with clear Kinetic accountability and auditable test evidence.

tasks.title: Implement transaction and blockchain monitoring / STR workflow
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Circular 3,978 monitoring/reporting framework; IN 704 Annex IV
tasks.why: On-chain monitoring has to connect to customer context, fiat movements and escalation decisions.
actions: Map Brazil typologies including PIX-to-crypto, rapid movement, layering, self-hosted wallets and high-risk counterparties.
Configure or validate Chainalysis/KYT rules and case routing.
Define alert disposition, investigation, escalation and STR/Coaf decision procedures.
Test coverage using representative Brazil scenarios.
Define record retention and management information.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Material Brazil transaction risks are covered by tested monitoring rules with documented investigation and reporting governance.

tasks.title: Sanctions / CPF blocking and authority-notification controls
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Brazil sanctions/CPF obligations, including Law 13,810/2019 as incorporated into AML controls
tasks.why: The operating model must be able to screen, freeze/block where legally required, escalate and document the response.
actions: Confirm applicable sanctions/CPF lists and screening coverage.
Define match handling, escalation, legal review, blocking and release workflow.
Define regulatory/authority notifications and evidence retention.
Test customer and transaction scenarios.
tasks.definitionOfDone: End-to-end sanctions/CPF response is documented, tested and owned.

tasks.title: AML governance, training, QA and recordkeeping
tasks.involved: HR; Compliance QA; Board; Internal Audit
tasks.why: Independent assurance will test governance and operating effectiveness, not just policy wording.
actions: Define AML governance calendar and management reporting.
Deliver role-based Brazil AML training to relevant staff.
Implement second-line QA over onboarding and monitoring cases.
Establish document and record-retention controls and evidence repositories.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Governance, training, QA and retention controls have operating evidence sufficient for assurance testing.
